subject: Admin activity snapshot: transport options, TTL & redaction approach
messages:
From: Audrey Klein <audrey.klein@acmehealth.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: compliance-team@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Admin activity exports - transport & TTL options

Hi Rafael,

Following up from our call — Acme Health's audit team needs clarity on the format and delivery options for admin activity (operator/admin) logs for a SIG/SOC2 review. Specifically: 

- Do you offer compressed snapshots (daily) and what transport options (S3 presigned, SFTP, signed HTTPS push) are supported?
- Can exports include an HMAC-signed manifest per bundle?
- What retention metadata is included (event timestamps, event_type, admin_id, request_id)?
- For PII-sensitive fields, do you provide a redaction map and can we request field-level suppression before export?

We expect a sample export and manifest for review. Ideally we'd like guidance on TTL options for short-term (30/90 days) vs archive (1/7 years) flows and any costs/lead times.

Thanks — can you please confirm and attach a small sample manifest if available?

Best,
Audrey
Audrey Klein
Senior Compliance Manager, Acme Health

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
To: Audrey Klein <audrey.klein@acmehealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Admin activity exports - transport & TTL options

Hi Audrey — thanks for the clear list. Short answer: we support compressed daily snapshots, multiple transport options, per-bundle manifests with HMAC, and configurable redaction prior to export. Below are specifics and an attached sample manifest.

What we can provide:
- Snapshot cadence: daily or on-demand (hourly available as an add-on). Files are gzipped CSV or parquet (you choose).
- Transport: S3 presigned URLs, SFTP push to a customer endpoint, or HTTPS (mutual-TLS) push. We can also stage to a restricted bucket and provide time-limited access.
- Manifest: JSON manifest per bundle including bundle_id, created_at (UTC), hmac_sha256, record_count, compression, and schema_version. We sign manifests with a rotating key and include key identifier in the manifest.
- Field-level metadata: exports include event_timestamp, event_type, actor_internal_id, request_id, resource_path, and a structured payload column.
- Redaction: We support pre-export redaction with a customer-provided redaction_map (we also ship a default map). Redaction is applied in-line before compression and export; we publish an attestable redaction log that lists the rule ids applied.
- Retention/TTL: We can slice snapshots by export date and provide retention tags in the manifest. Typical flows: 30/90-day short-term retention (fast access) or archival retention (1/7 years) with cold storage transfers.

Attached is a small sample: admin_activity_manifest-20260817.csv.gz (stub) and redaction_map_v1.xlsx. 

Next steps:
1) Tell us preferred transport and cadence.
2) If you need HSM-backed manifest signing, we'll route to our security team and kick an approval (adds ~5 business days).
3) Share any fields you want suppressed in exports; we can draft a redaction_map and run a one-off sample.

Cc'ing Kimberly and Marissa to coordinate packaging and delivery.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Security Integrations
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Admin activity exports - transport & TTL options

Rafael / team — operational notes:

- Packaging: we'll produce gzipped CSV by default with an option for parquet. For Acme's SOC2/ SIG, CSV + manifest is fine.
- Manifest signing: default manifests are signed with our key rotation layer; for Acme's request for HMAC we will include hmac_sha256 and key_id in the manifest. If they insist on an HSM-signed attestation, escalate (adds lead time).
- Redaction: propose we run two samples: (A) full export with redaction_map_v1 applied, (B) a redacted-only export where payload.nullify(fields) removes PII and we add redaction_report.csv in the bundle.
- Retention TTL: implement export tags: retention_tier=short|archive, retention_days=30|365|2555 (7 years). We'll tag each bundle and include TTL in manifest (expires_at).
- Transport: for onboarding let's offer S3 presigned and SFTP. HTTPS-mTLS requires cert exchange and extra ops time.

Action items for Acme ask:
- Rafael: confirm whether Acme needs HSM attestation or HMAC-level is sufficient.
- Marissa: please prepare a one-off sample bundle (daily snapshot, redaction_map_v1 applied) and upload to our test SFTP. Attach manifest stub and redaction_report.

I'll also document the per-bundle field list we include to close the remaining question about what metadata appears in the export.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Product Security Manager, Redwood Inference
